wrong: pushed a skipped (Not proven) test as PASSED in Xray with a 'checked by hand' comment
right: a skipped test stays TO DO or goes to the user as a manual test
rule: before any Xray status push, compare with work/<KEY>/run-results.json: a skipped / fixme / Not proven test is never PASSED, whatever the reason

wrong: Specs used filter/search/delete steps that were never checked live: Select All toggled while a search text hid options, search box typed without Enter, deleteWork returned silently when the row was not drawn and waited for a deleted row to disappear, Deck tag removed without opening the editor
right: Filter: clear search, untick Select All to none, then tick exact labels; table search needs Enter; deleted works stay in the grid with Status text D; cleanup must find the row (scroll) and fail loudly
caught: user answered script bug for TC-008/009/019/020 after a live Chrome check (2026-11-24)
rule: Before writing a UI step that filters, searches or deletes, check how the page really behaves (UI facts doc or a live check by the lead) and never let a helper return silently when its target is not found

wrong: ETM-8736 pasted a fixed Start date (05 Jun 2026) that fails the plan schedule check, so the app reverted the whole paste
right: pasted dates must come from the target rows' own schedule (e.g. current Start + 1 day), inside the plan window
rule: Never hard-code a date for a Shutdown Logic paste; derive it from the row's current dates

wrong: ETM-8737 expected the seeded Duration 12 to show as 12; the app fits Duration to the working calendar (10.00)
right: after seeding, read the value the row shows and use it as the expected value
rule: Never expect a pasted Shutdown Logic Duration/date to show the typed number; read the row's value after the seed
